expected: One marketplace-not-added payload with the typed name, the reason marketplace not added, and no scope field, for autoupdate tools, noautoupdate tools, and autoupdate 工具
actual: The same payload with one extra scope field of project in each of the three examples
semanticAssessment: All three examples ran Pi startup and both Given steps, then ran the flip command. Each failed only at the result has these fields step, and each diff is exactly one extra [scope, project] row; every other field matched. The config assertions after it were skipped. This is the D-08 defect: notifyNamedMiss defaults a missing --scope to project.
